'''Mike D'Amboise''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 29th, 4 (−24) at [[RamapoCon II Team Championship]] on 7 May 2000, according to Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d714">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-ramapocon-ii-day-3-director-reportd714/ ramapocon-ii-day-3-director-report], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 9 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-ramapocon-ii-day-3-director-reportd714/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
